title: Lesson 2 Quiz: How Transactions Move From Sender to Receiver

questions.text: What is the mempool in a cryptocurrency network?
options: A permanent ledger of all confirmed transactions
A pool of unconfirmed transactions waiting to be included in a block
The cryptographic hash that links blocks together
A list of fees paid to miners for block creation
questions.explanation: After a transaction is broadcast to the peer-to-peer network, it waits in the mempool, the pool of unconfirmed transactions waiting to be included in a block.

questions.text: The transaction is signed with the private key before it is broadcast to the network.
questions.explanation: True. The steps run: initiation in the wallet, signing with the private key, then broadcasting to the peer-to-peer network.
